# LibreWaterNet.org
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Until 2026-09-17 this host answered 404 for /robots.txt, so there was no
# Sitemap line on the property at all. The sitemap that lists this site's 542 URLs is generated by
# the EngCalcs repository and written to the OTHER host's root, because that is where the parent
# site lives -- see dev/scripts/generate_sitemap.php there. Google honours a sitemap that lists one
# host and is served from another only when BOTH properties are verified by the same owner, which
# they are; but it still has to FIND it, and from this property there was nothing to find.
#
# Tom, 2026-09-17: "LibreWaterNet.org is there as a property, but there is no sitemap listed. I have
# never submitted a sitemap."
#
# THE SITEMAP URL IS DELIBERATELY ON THE OTHER HOST and is not a mistake. Pointing it at a copy here
# would be a second sitemap of the same URLs, which is the arrangement that drifts.
